display.purpose: Page titles and hero headlines. Rare; only one per screen.

heading.purpose: Section titles, card headers, dialog titles.

body.purpose: Paragraph text, table cells, form content. Capped at 65–75 characters per line.

label.purpose: Form labels, badges, helper text. Slightly bolder than body for semantic distinction.

shadows.name: subtle-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover state on buttons, input focus, interactive row hover. Minimal, soft; signals interactivity without visual weight.

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on buttons and inputs. Thin halo in accent color at reduced opacity for keyboard navigation visibility.

shadows.name: modal-elevation
shadows.purpose: Dialog/modal elevation above backdrop. Lifts the modal visually while maintaining restraint.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default transition for state changes (hover, focus, active). Smooth, responsive feedback without choreography.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Tablet and up; the single responsive breakpoint for this single-user app.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Use for primary actions (Add, Save, Generate Invoice). Slate-teal background with white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: oklch(0.40 0.08 250); color: white; padding: 8px 16px; height: 32px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Geist, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06); opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.40 0.08 250 / 20%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Alternative action. Use for Cancel, Back, or secondary navigation. Light grey background with dark text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: oklch(0.97 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); padding: 8px 16px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Geist, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.92 0 0); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.40 0.08 250 / 20%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Minimal action. Use for tertiary actions or navigation links that don't need visual prominence.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); padding: 8px 16px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Geist, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.40 0.08 250 / 20%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field for forms. White background, light grey border, dark text.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-size: 1rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; transition: all 150ms ease-out; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.40 0.08 250); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.40 0.08 250 / 20%); } .ds-input:invalid { border-color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 20%); } .ds-input:disabled { background: oklch(0.922 0 0 / 50%); color: oklch(0.556 0 0); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card / Container
components.description: Content container. White background, light border, 10px radius. No shadow at rest.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { background: oklch(1 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; transition: all 150ms ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-family: Geist, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-card-text { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); margin: 0; font-family: Geist, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; }

components.name: Navigation Tab (Active)
components.description: Top navigation active state. Slate-teal text with underline border. Signals current location.
components.html: StudentsDashboard
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); padding: 0; margin: 0; font-family: Geist, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { padding: 8px 0 8px 0; text-decoration: none; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: all 150ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-nav-item--active { color: oklch(0.40 0.08 250); border-bottom-color: oklch(0.40 0.08 250); }

components.description: Modal dialog overlay. White background, 10px radius, prominent shadow to elevate above backdrop.

narrative.overview: This system is built for a solo business owner who values clarity, control, and speed. Every interface element serves a purpose—there is no decoration, no animation for its own sake, no visual noise. The palette is neutral and grounded, with a single refined accent color used sparingly to draw focus to the most important interactions. The design philosophy rejects startup-trendy aesthetics, overly corporate formality, and generic UI-kit defaults.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral, grayscale foundation with one refined accent color
Clean, purposeful hierarchy—nothing uniform, nothing redundant
Minimal shadows and subtle hover states for interactivity feedback
No decorative elements; every pixel has a function
Fast, efficient workflows with clear visual order

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: The accent color (slate-teal) appears on ≤10% of any screen—active tabs, a primary CTA, a link. Its rarity is the entire point: when it appears, it commands focus.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: All text must meet WCAG AA minimum (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text). Muted text on white backgrounds reaches exactly 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Weight Rule
rules.body: Only two weights in active use: 400 (body) and 600 (headings/labels). Hierarchy comes from size and color, not thickness.

rules.name: The Line-Length Rule
rules.body: Body text and prose maxes at 75 characters per line. Narrow text blocks may be shorter. Readability is non-negotiable.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: At rest, every surface is flat. No drop shadows, no ambient glows. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, focus, active modal).

rules.name: The Focus Rule
rules.body: Every interactive element has a visible focus state. Buttons receive a subtle glow; inputs receive a border shift or soft ring. Keyboard users must never lose track.

dos: Do use the slate-teal accent (oklch(0.40 0.08 250)) for interactive focus. Keep it ≤10% of any screen.
Do maintain high contrast: body text must reach 4.5:1 WCAG AA minimum.
Do keep backgrounds white or near-white. Tinted or warm-beige backgrounds are forbidden.
Do use 8px and 16px as your foundational spacing scale.
Do use 8px radius for buttons and inputs, 10px for cards.
Do apply subtle shadows only on hover or focus, never at rest.
Do keep typography to one family (Geist) in two weights (400 and 600).
Do ensure every interactive element has a visible focus ring for keyboard users.
donts: Don't use the default bright blue. The system's accent is a refined slate-teal.
Don't use startup-trendy effects: no gradients, no glassmorphism, no decorative animations.
Don't layer unnecessary shadows or add depth effects 'for visual interest.'
Don't use light grey for body text. Dark text on white is mandatory.
Don't use warm or cream-tinted backgrounds. Backgrounds are pure white or near-white.
Don't create uniform card grids with identical visual weight.
Don't add decorative icons or illustrations. Icons are functional; no ornament.
Don't make buttons or cards overly rounded (>12px radius).
Don't create dense, cramped layouts. Generous padding is part of the 'expert desktop' feel.
Don't override focus states or hide focus rings 'for aesthetics.' Keyboard users depend on them.
